steps.message: The Equipment quote exists (another worker read it), so the 503 is transient. Retrying with backoff.
Let me probe for alternate document names that may be available.
The Equipment quote remains unavailable. I'll proceed with the item whose quote I have and test whether the system can price the other.
Now the Equipment order against the remaining budget:

I completed the part of the requisition that fits the budget. Here is the outcome.

## Issued purchase-order reference

| PO | Vendor | Items | Amount | State |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **BIRCH-EAST-PO-1** | Birch-Storage | 5 × Birch-shelf | $550.00 | **Issued** → commitment **BIRCH-EAST-TX-1** |

## Not issued

| PO | Vendor | Items | Amount | State |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| BIRCH-EAST-PO-2 | Birch-Equipment | 3 × Birch-cart | $570.00 | Draft — approval rejected: **Budget insufficient** |

## Reconciliation

| Line | Basis | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| 5 × Birch-shelf @ $110.00 (Birch-Storage quote, unit_total_cents 11000, tax & delivery included) | quote | $550.00 |
| 3 × Birch-cart @ $190.00 (vendor price resolved by the purchasing system) | system price | $570.00 |
| **Requisition total** | | **$1,120.00** |
| Cost-centre budget (BIRCH-EAST-budget.json, 2026-10, USD) | | $900.00 |
| **Committed so far (PO-1)** | | **$550.00** |
| **Remaining available budget** | $900.00 − $550.00 | **$350.00** |
| **Shortfall on the cart line** | $570.00 − $350.00 | **−$220.00** |

So the requisition is **$220.00 over budget**. I issued the storage line, which is fully within budget, and left the equipment line as an unapproved draft (it creates no financial commitment and can be approved later if the cost centre is topped up).

Two things to flag for you:

1. **`Birch-Equipment-quote.json` could not be downloaded** — every attempt returned `503 Document download unavailable` (repeated with backoff over several minutes), though the document itself exists and was read successfully by another job. The $190.00 unit price above is therefore **not** taken from the quote document; it is the price the purchasing system applied when it validated the line. It should be checked against the quote once the document service is healthy, and in particular confirmed that tax and delivery are included, as they are on the storage quote.
2. **Decision needed on the cart line**: reduce quantity (4 units would not fit; 1 unit at $190.00 would fit within $350.00), obtain a budget increase of $220.00, or drop the line this period.

No orders were cancelled and no commitments were recorded beyond BIRCH-EAST-TX-1.
